Machine Capability Analysis for Your SMT Reflow Oven using KIC SRA Smart Reflow Analyser

 PrevPreviousPre Reflow Inspection for PCBs 
 NextKeep Your Component Stocks and Inventory Value AccurateNext 
Identify and Track your SMT Reflow Oven Performance and Stability over time using KIC’s SRA (Smart Reflow Analyser).
KIC SRA Smart Reflow Analyser
The KIC SRA Smart Fixture with built-In data collection & laser technology for accurate conveyor speed measurement provides critical machine validation data. Combined with KIC’s analysis software it creates a unique Heat Transfer Index (HTI)™ for each zone, allowing for side-to-side and run-to-run comparisons and can even track individual zone performance over time.
As with all KIC thermal profiling products the data is brought into focus with KICs Process Window Index measurement, PWI™ an instant process analysis with a single number.
A Single screen overview with key machine information provides the user with a powerful machine verification tool which can be used to identify maintenance needs or to confirm return to normal process conditions after maintenance.
HTI – Heat Transfer Index™
A measure of a zone’s energy transfer in a single number.
The HTI™, or Heat Transfer Index, is a measure of the energy transfer occurring in a given zone. Effective heat transfer will generally yield a more homogeneous board temp (tight delta temperature across all components) and can allow for faster conveyor speeds (more throughput). The HTI value is calculated and displayed for each zone as a single number. The display of this index allows for fast and easy identification of changes in the performance of a given zone.
